subject: CAIQ: live evidence playtest and control-owner liaison
body:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Cc: BrightAudit <audit@brightaudit.com>, FinServe Security <security@finserve.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ: live evidence playtest and control-owner liaison

Hi team —

We have a short-window request from FinServe (cc'd) to run a CAIQ playtest: BrightAudit will do a live sampling of a handful of mapped controls so they can validate artifacts and execution traces end-to-end. The ask is operational: provide the evidence (logs, retention excerpts, runbooks, configuration screenshots, short telemetry queries) for a small control subset, then join a 1.5–2 hour walkthrough during which auditors will exercise queries and confirm traceability back to the CAIQ answers.

I attached the playtest instructions and a CSV with the initial sample of controls. Please review and nominate the owner(s) who will join the walkthrough and supply the artifacts. High-level asks below:

- Target window: Monday May 3, 10:00–12:00 PT (we can slide +/- 2 hours if needed)
- Deliverables (by EOD Friday Apr 30):
  * Retention policy excerpt for logs/telemetry (where applicable)
  * Runbook or SOP snippet that shows how the control is exercised (1–2 pages)
  * Example telemetry query (KQL/SQL/Cloud logging) and a 24–72h sample output
  * Configuration screenshots or concise export of settings (redact customer PII)
  * Short rationale note tying each artifact to the CAIQ control ID (1–2 lines each)
- Owners: please confirm who will be present for the live run and who will own artifact uploads
- Access: we will provide a temporary auditor service account and a read-only folder in Drive for artifacts

Attachments:
- caiq-mapping-playtest-instructions.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
- caiq-control-sample-list.csv (csv, 7KB)

Markus — can you take the initial owner assignment for infra/telemetry controls? Kimberly — can you take control owners for identity/access and key rotation items?

Thanks — short timeline here so appreciate quick confirmations.

Best,
Naomi Feldman
Security & Compliance Program Manager
Redwood Inference

---

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 11:08 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
> To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
> Cc: BrightAudit <audit@brightaudit.com>, FinServe Security <security@finserve.com>
> Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -0700
> Subject: Re: CAIQ: live evidence playtest and control-owner liaison
>
> Naomi — thanks for the heads up. I can own the infra/telemetry slice. Quick clarifications:
>
> 1) For retention, do auditors need the full policy file or a short excerpt tied to the control? I assume an excerpt is fine but happy to provide the full policy if they prefer.
> 2) For logs we will need to scrub any customer-identifying fields; is there guidance on what to remove beyond emails/SSNs?
>
> I can get the runbooks and sample queries ready by EOD Friday. If we need to provide pre-sampled output, please confirm the timestamp window auditors want.
>
> —Markus
> Markus Klein
> Director, Platform Reliability
> Redwood Inference

On Thu, Apr 29, 2027 at 2:22 PM BrightAudit <audit@brightaudit.com> wrote:

> From: BrightAudit <audit@brightaudit.com>
> To: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
> Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 14:22:00 -0400
> Subject: RE: CAIQ: live evidence playtest and control-owner liaison
>
> Hi Naomi/Markus — thanks for coordinating. A few quick items from our side: we prefer the concise excerpt approach (policy excerpt + pointer to full doc). For logs, redact customer identifiers; removing email addresses and account IDs is sufficient for our sampling work.
>
> Sample controls we'd like to validate in this session (suggested subset):
> - CSA-IG-01 (Access provisioning & lifecycle)
> - CSA-OP-07 (Logging and monitoring coverage)
> - CSA-CR-02 (Backup cadence and restore evidence)
> - CSA-EN-03 (Key management operational evidence)
>
> We will need a pre-authorized, time-bound read-only user or service account for Drive and a short (2-hour) access window starting at the scheduled time. Please provide a contact we can ping on Slack during the run.
>
> Also please add Kimberly Park as the primary identity/contact for access controls — we will focus our queries there.
>
> Thanks,
> Elena Rodriguez
> Senior Auditor
> BrightAudit
> audit@brightaudit.com

On Fri, Apr 30, 2027 at 15:45:00 -0700 Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com> wrote:

> From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
> To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
> Cc: BrightAudit <audit@brightaudit.com>, FinServe Security <security@finserve.com>
> Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 15:45:00 -0700
> Subject: RE: CAIQ: live evidence playtest and control-owner liaison
>
> Team — scheduling confirm: Monday May 3, 10:00–12:00 PT. Calendar invites sent (link below).
>
> Action items I captured:
> - Markus: provide runbook snippets, telemetry queries + sample output (24h export) — due EOD Apr 30 (accepted)
> - Kimberly: identity/account screenshots and short owner note for CSA-IG-01 — due EOD Apr 30 (accepted)
> - Naomi: provision auditor service account and Drive folder; upload instruction attachment and CSV mapping
>
> Access details (temporary):
> - Auditor service account: bright-auditor@redwood-audits.iam.gserviceaccount.com (read-only)
> - Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/naomi/redwood/caiq-playtest (shared with auditor account)
> - Pre-signed access window: 2027-05-03T17:00:00Z to 2027-05-03T19:00:00Z
>
> Attachments uploaded to folder include the two files referenced earlier. Please do not include customer PII in uploads; redact where necessary.
>
> Elena — thanks for the control list. We will prioritize CSA-OP-07 and CSA-IG-01 for the run; if we have time we will bring in EN-03.
>
> If anything changes I will update the calendar. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
>
> Best,
> Naomi Feldman
> Security & Compliance Program Manager
> Redwood Inference
>
> Attachment stubs:
> - caiq-mapping-playtest-instructions.pdf (pdf, 48KB)
> - caiq-control-sample-list.csv (csv, 7KB)
